text: Big presentation tomorrow and I keep rehearsing what could go wrong.
This deadline is going to kill me lol
My manager hasn't replied to my email and I'm spiralling.
I'm dying of embarrassment after that meeting.
Too many tasks, I don't know where to start.
Performance review on Friday. Stomach in knots.
I said something dumb on the team call and keep replaying it.
I could murder a coffee right now, been up since 4 worrying about the audit.
Layoff rumours at work and I can't focus.
My heart races before every one-to-one, like always. I know it's nerves.
I feel like I'm falling apart and I can't stop crying.
Everything feels hopeless at work right now.
Sometimes I wish I could just disappear for a while.
Had like six drinks to calm down and it's not working.
I keep thinking everyone would be fine without me around.
I'm so tired of everything. I don't really see the point anymore.
I want to kill myself.
I don’t want to be alive anymore.
I've decided tonight is the night I end things.
I've been looking up how many of my pills it would take.
Honestly hurting myself is the only thing that makes the panic stop.
I wrote letters to my family in case I'm not here next week.
I took all my pills about an hour ago.
I can't breathe and my lips are going blue.
I just cut myself and it won't stop bleeding.
Crushing chest pain going down my left arm, sweating.
If he says that again I'm going to hurt him.
I keep picturing bringing a knife to work.
My partner said he'd hurt me if I tell anyone. I'm scared to go home.
He took my phone and locked me in again last night.
I'm 15 and my exam is tomorrow.
My teacher shouted at me in front of the whole of year 10.
My chest is tight and my heart is pounding before the meeting.
Feeling dizzy and faint thinking about the client call.
